records.jp: これって、都ちゃんのスマホケース？<CR>なんか声も聞こえるけど……
records.en_original: This phone case...is this Miyako's phone? I think I hear her voice, too.
records.en: Is this Miyako-chan's phone case?<CR>I can hear a voice too...

records.jp: これは具現化した誰かの想いみたいだけど、<CR>こんなしっかり形になってるのは初めて見たよ
records.en_original: Seems like this is a manifestation of someone's feelings, but I've never seen them take such a distinct form before.
records.en: It looks like someone's feelings have materialized,<CR>but I've never seen them take such a solid form before.

records.jp: ……驚いた。この想いは二人のフラグメントの破片を<CR>包むようにして形成されてる
records.en_original: Wow... These feelings have taken shape around the shards of both of your Fragments.
records.en: Wow... These feelings have taken shape around the shards<CR>of both of your Fragments.

records.jp: 二人の想いに反応して、破片が崩壊しないように<CR>守ってくれてるのかもしれない
records.en_original: Maybe it's reacting to your feelings and protecting the shards so they don't fall apart.
records.en: Maybe it's reacting to your feelings and protecting the shards<CR>so they don't fall apart.

records.jp: そうなの？
records.en_original: Really?
records.en: Really?

records.jp: 多分。ライムもこんな現象見たことないし。<CR>けど、破片が核になってるのは間違いない
records.en_original: Probably. I've never seen anything like this before, but one thing's for sure—the shards have formed a core.
records.en: Probably. Lime hasn't seen anything like this either.<CR>But there's no doubt the shards are forming the core.

records.jp: ってことはこれ、触ればいいの？
records.en_original: So, does this mean we should touch it?
records.en: So, does this mean we should touch it?

records.jp: それで問題ないはず
records.en_original: Yes, that should be fine.
records.en: Yes, that should be fine.

records.jp: ああ、やっと繋がった
records.en_original: Ah, I finally got through!
records.en: Ah, I finally got through!

records.jp: 白樺さん！<CR>これ、もしかして本当に電話が繋がってるの？
records.en_original: Miyako! Wait, are we really talking on the phone right now?
records.en: Shirakaba-san!<CR>Wait, are we really talking on the phone right now?

records.jp: まさか。私は都の想いが具現化したものよ。<CR>現実の私は、今もあんたたちを待ってるわ
records.en_original: Psh, as if. I'm just the physical form of Miyako's feelings. The real me is still waiting for you all out there.
records.en: Psh, as if. I'm just the physical form of Miyako's feelings.<CR>The real me is still waiting for you all out there.

records.jp: てか、どうして二人だけなの？<CR>モモさんたちは？
records.en_original: Wait, why are there only two of you? Where's Momo and the others?
records.en: Wait, why are there only two of you?<CR>Where are Momo-san and the others?

records.jp: ここに来た時に離れ離れになっちゃって……
records.en_original: We all got separated when we arrived here...
records.en: We all got separated when we arrived here...

records.jp: そうなんだ……紫乃を相手に二人だけじゃ不安だし、<CR>早く合流できればいいんだけど……
records.en_original: I see... I'd be worried going up against Shino with just the two of you. I hope you all can meet up soon.
records.en: I see... I'd be worried going up against Shino with just the two of you.<CR>I hope you all can meet up soon.

records.jp: あ、それなんだけど、実は……
records.en_original: Oh, actually, about that...
records.en: Oh, actually, about that...

records.jp: なるほどね……事情はわかった
records.en_original: I see... I understand the situation.
records.en: I see... I understand the situation.

records.jp: そのうえで言わせてもらうけど、<CR>バカなこと言ってないで、さっさと紫乃を止めなさいよ
records.en_original: Let me just say this: Stop spouting nonsense and go stop Shino already!
records.en: Let me just say this:<CR>Stop spouting nonsense and go stop Shino already!

records.jp: ば、バカなことって……
records.en_original: N-nonsense?
records.en: N-nonsense?

records.jp: 白樺さん、確かに私たちも最初はそう思ってたけど、<CR>紫乃の気持ちを考えたら……
records.en_original: We felt the same at first, Miyako. But when we thought about Shino's feelings...
records.en: We felt the same at first, Shirakaba-san.<CR>But when we thought about Shino's feelings...

records.jp: 同情すべき点があるのは認める。<CR>それについては私も同意見
records.en_original: I have to admit, there are parts of her perspective we should feel empathy for. I agree with you there.
records.en: I admit there are parts of her situation I can sympathize with.<CR>I agree with you on that.

records.jp: それでも紫乃を止めようって決めたのは、<CR>あんたたちでしょ？
records.en_original: But you're the ones who decided to stop Shino, right?
records.en: But you're the ones who decided to stop Shino,<CR>right?

records.jp: ずっとフラグメントを集めてる紫乃たちと戦いながら、<CR>この世界を守るために頑張り続けて
records.en_original: You've been working so hard to protect this world, fighting Shino and the others while collecting Fragments.
records.en: You've been working so hard to protect this world, fighting Shino<CR>and the others while collecting Fragments.

records.jp: とうとうコモンにまで行ったその瞬間に<CR>気持ちが変わるなんて、おかしいと思わないわけ！？
records.en_original: You finally made it all the way to the Common, and now you're gonna back down? Are you even in your right minds?!
records.en: You finally made it all the way to the Common,<CR>and now you're gonna back down? Are you even in your right minds?!

records.jp: み、都ちゃん、落ち着いて！
records.en_original: M-Miyako, calm down!
records.en: M-Miyako-chan, calm down!

records.jp: あんたたちは、ずっと大勢の人を守るために<CR>戦い続けてきた
records.en_original: You've always fought so hard to protect everyone.
records.en: You've always fought so hard to protect<CR>everyone.

records.jp: なのに今、その努力を自分で踏みにじってる
records.en_original: And now you're just going to throw away all that effort?
records.en: And now you're just going to throw away all that effort?

records.jp: やめてよ……そんなかっこ悪い姿、見せないでよ
records.en_original: Please don't... You're better than that. I know you are.
records.en: Please don't... You're better than that. I know you are.

records.jp: 都ちゃん……
records.en_original: Miyako...
records.en: Miyako-chan...

records.jp: 前に……もう結構前になるんだっけ
records.en_original: I can't believe so much time has passed since back then...
records.en: Back then... I guess it was quite a while ago now.

records.jp: 優秀な兄と比べられてた私は、家族にとっては<CR>何も期待されていない、いらない子だった
records.en_original: Compared to my talented brother, I was the kid no one expected anything from—my family didn't even need me around.
records.en: Compared to my talented brother, I was the kid no one expected<CR>anything from—my family didn't even need me around.

records.jp: それに絶望してフラグメントを抜かれかけた時、<CR>助けてくれたのはあんたたちだったでしょ？
records.en_original: I was so hopeless, I almost lost my Fragment... You were the ones who saved me, remember?
records.en: I was so hopeless, I almost lost my Fragment...<CR>You were the ones who saved me, remember?

records.jp: あの時から、私はずっと思ってた
records.en_original: Ever since then, I've always felt the same as you.
records.en: Ever since then, I've always thought...

records.jp: 私も、誰かの想いを守れる人になりたい。<CR>あんたたちの力になれる人になりたい
records.en_original: I want to be the kind of person who can protect the feelings of others. Someone who can be there for you all as well.
records.en: I want to be someone who can protect other people's feelings.<CR>Someone who can be there for all of you too.

records.jp: 私みたいな想いを、他の人がしないように、って
records.en_original: So nobody else ever has to feel the way I did.
records.en: So nobody else ever has to feel the way I did.

records.jp: 白樺さん、そんなことを……
records.en_original: Miyako, I never knew you felt that way...
records.en: Shirakaba-san, I never knew you felt that way...

records.jp: 由紀姫のこと、覚えてる？
records.en_original: Do you remember what happened with Princess Yuki?
records.en: Do you remember what happened with Princess Yuki?

records.jp: あの時、暴走しかけていた由紀姫のフラグメントを<CR>止めようと思ったのも、あんたたちの影響なんだから
records.en_original: You inspired me to stop Yukiko's Fragment when she was about to lose control.
records.en: You inspired me to stop Yukiko's Fragment<CR>when she was about to lose control.

records.jp: あんなに必死に、心から助けたいって<CR>気持ちになれたのは、あれが初めてだった
records.en_original: That was the first time I ever felt the burning urge to help someone from the bottom of my heart.
records.en: That was the first time I'd ever wanted so badly<CR>to help someone with all my heart.

records.jp: あんたたちのおかげで、<CR>私はそんな人になることができた
records.en_original: Now that's exactly the kind of person I am, and it's all thanks to you.
records.en: Thanks to all of you,<CR>I was able to become that kind of person.

records.jp: だからコモンや、想いを救うために戦う力を<CR>持ってるあんたたちを見てると……本当に悔しい
records.en_original: So seeing you who have the strength to save the Common and protect everyone, it honestly makes me jealous.
records.en: So when I see you with the power to save the Common<CR>and fight to protect people's feelings... it really frustrates me.

records.jp: 都ちゃん……
records.en_original: Miyako...
records.en: Miyako-chan...

records.jp: でも、同じくらいあんたたちのこと、<CR>すごくかっこいいと思ってる
records.en_original: But at the same time, I think you're both so amazing.
records.en: But at the same time,<CR>I think you're both so amazing.

records.jp: だから、紫乃の思い通りにならないでほしい。<CR>そんなかっこ悪いこと、言わないで
records.en_original: So please, don't just cave to what Shino wants. Don't say things that aren't true to yourselves.
records.en: So please don't let Shino have her way.<CR>Don't say anything so lame.

records.jp: お願いだから……
records.en_original: Please...
records.en: Please...

records.jp: ……って、ごめんごめん。<CR>勝手なこと言い過ぎだね
records.en_original: Sorry. I know I'm saying too much.
records.en: Sorry.<CR>I know I'm saying too much.

records.jp: 私だってフラグメントを抜かれかけたんだから、<CR>今のあんたたちの状態も、なんとなくわかるのに
records.en_original: I almost lost my Fragment, too, so I get how you must be feeling right now.
records.en: I almost lost my Fragment, too,<CR>so I get how you must be feeling right now.

records.jp: 今はさ、飛び散った破片を集めて、<CR>あんたたちを元に戻すことが先決よね
records.en_original: What's most important right now is gathering the scattered shards and getting back to your normal selves.
records.en: What's most important right now is gathering the scattered shards<CR>and getting back to your normal selves.

records.jp: ……ごめんなさい。<CR>なんか、がっかりさせちゃったみたいで……
records.en_original: I'm sorry... It feels like we've let you down.
records.en: I'm sorry...<CR>It feels like we've let you down.

records.jp: いいって、状況わかったから
records.en_original: Don't worry about it, I understand what's going on.
records.en: Don't worry about it, I understand what's going on.

records.jp: 今はまだ、紫乃の方に傾いてると思うけどさ、<CR>私は信じてるから
records.en_original: I know you might still be veering towards Shino's view on things for now, but...know that I believe in you.
records.en: I know you might still be veering towards Shino's view on things for now,<CR>but...know that I believe in you.

records.jp: 紫乃を救って、この世の理も正して、<CR>無事に帰ってくるって……
records.en_original: I believe you'll save Shino, set this world right, and come back safe.
records.en: I believe you'll save Shino, set this world right,<CR>and come back safe.

records.jp: ……ありがとう、白樺さん
records.en_original: Thank you, Miyako.
records.en: Thank you, Shirakaba-san.

records.jp: 早く、現実の私を安心させてあげてね。<CR>それじゃ
records.en_original: Hurry up and put my real self at ease, okay? I'll see you later.
records.en: Hurry up and put my real self at ease, okay?<CR>I'll see you later.

records.jp: よかった。<CR>ちゃんと二人に戻ったみたい
records.en_original: What a relief. Looks like you really did turn back into yourselves.
records.en: What a relief.<CR>Looks like you really did turn back into yourselves.

records.jp: ……いいお友達ね
records.en_original: You have such good friends.
records.en: You have such good friends.

records.jp: うん……あんな風に想っててくれたなんて、<CR>ずっと気づかなかった
records.en_original: Yeah... I never realized she thought about me that way.
records.en: Yeah... I never realized she thought<CR>about me that way.

records.jp: なのに私たち……ガッカリさせちゃったかも……
records.en_original: And despite that, we might have let her down...
records.en: And despite that, we might have let her down...

records.jp: 最後にかっこいいところ見せれば、<CR>あの子も喜んでくれると思うよ
records.en_original: If you show her you're worth looking up to in the end, I'm sure she'll forgive and forget.
records.en: If you show her how cool you can be in the end,<CR>I'm sure she'll be happy too.

records.jp: ……そうだといいんだけど
records.en_original: I sure hope so.
records.en: I sure hope so.

records.jp: それに、あなたたちが想いに触れたことで、<CR>この世界にもいい影響があったみたい
records.en_original: Also, when you touched those feelings, it seems like it brought something good into this world too.
records.en: Also, when you touched those feelings,<CR>it seems like it brought something good into this world too.

records.jp: この世界に？
records.en_original: Into this world?
records.en: Into this world?

records.jp: うん、想いに触れた瞬間に、<CR>ちょっとだけど
records.en_original: Yeah, just for a moment, when you connected to those feelings.
records.en: Yeah, just for a moment,<CR>when you connected to those feelings.

records.jp: そう……なの？
records.en_original: Really?
records.en: Really?

records.jp: これはライムたちも想定していなかった事態。<CR>けど、これは世界にとってもいいことに間違いない
records.en_original: We didn't expect something like this would happen, but I'm sure it's a good thing for the Common.
records.en: We didn't expect this either.<CR>But I'm sure this is a good thing for the world.

records.jp: 想いに包まれた破片は他にもあるはずだよ。<CR>見つけたら、また触ってみよう
records.en_original: There must be other shards wrapped in feelings out there. If we find any more, let's be sure and touch them.
records.en: There must be other shards wrapped in feelings out there.<CR>If we find any more, let's be sure and touch them.
